literature.headline_zh: 人肠道病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人肠道病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 进一步发现临床诊断与实验室确认之间存在很大差距,这表明有必要加强基于实验室的监测。 [10.1080/17460794.2026.2728541]

2025年7月EV-D68阳性率上升,8月达到峰值(约21%),并在9月至10月保持较高水平,超过了2024年观察到的水平。系统发育分析显示仅A2亚群在流行,其中五株基因组形成了一条独特的重组谱系(A2-Re),在P1区域与A2病毒聚类,在P2–P3区域与B3病毒聚类。在2A/2B接合处附近(约nt 3,700)发现了一个重组断点,该重组谱系与9月至10月期间的时间聚集病例相关。 [10.1128/spectrum.01005-26]
进一步分析表明,从粗砂到淤泥,灭活速率常数范围为 0.002 至 0.004 min-1,这表明较细沉积物中的病毒-固体界面反应性增强。 [10.1021/acs.est.6c03626]
我们的结果表明,这种病毒对胰腺、肝脏和骨骼肌表现出强烈的趋向性,导致这些器官出现广泛的炎症。 [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117450]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Further a substantial gap was found between clinical diagnosis and laboratory confirmation, which advocates the necessity of strengthening laboratory-based surveillance. [10.1080/17460794.2026.2728541]
EV-D68 positivity increased in July 2025, peaked in August (~21%), and remained elevated through September and October, exceeding levels observed in 2024. [10.1128/spectrum.01005-26]
A total of 137,460 diagnoses were identified, including 54,060 herpangina and 83,400 HFMD. [10.1097/inf.0000000000005377]

Further analysis showed that inactivation rate constants ranged from 0.002 to 0.004 min-1 from coarse sand to silt, suggesting enhanced virus-solid interface reactivity in finer sediments. [10.1021/acs.est.6c03626]
Our results demonstrated that this virus exhibited a strong tropism for the pancreas, liver, and skeletal muscles, leading to extensive inflammation in these organs. [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117450]

papers.title: Genomic surveillance of enterovirus D68 circulating in 2025 reveals the emergence of a novel A2/B3 recombinant lineage
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) has re-emerged over the past decade as a significant respiratory pathogen associated with severe respiratory disease and acute flaccid myelitis. Its circulation has typically followed a biennial pattern, with predominance in late summer and early fall, a pattern that was temporarily disrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic. Surveillance in 2025 revealed off-season circulation of EV-D68. This study describes the genomic characteristics of the 2025 EV-D68 viruses and the clinical features of affected patients. Between May and December 2025, remnant respiratory specimens positive for rhinovirus/enterovirus were screened for EV-D68 and subjected to whole-genome sequencing. Phylogenetic analyses were performed using maximum-likelihood methods. Recombination was assessed using subgenomic phylogenies, SimPlot similarity and BootScan analyses, and read-level inspection. Among 1,321 patients tested, 147 (11.1%) were EV-D68-positive, and 119 (81.0%) yielded complete genomes. EV-D68 positivity increased in July 2025, peaked in August (~21%), and remained elevated through September and October, exceeding levels observed in 2024. Patients had a median age of 36 years, with infections disproportionately affecting older adults. Phylogenetic analysis demonstrated exclusive circulation of subclade A2. Five genomes formed a distinct recombinant lineage (A2-Re). Subgenomic phylogenies showed clustering with A2 viruses in the P1 region and with B3 viruses in the P2–P3 regions. SimPlot and BootScan analyses identified a recombination breakpoint near the 2A/2B junction (~nt 3,700). The recombinant lineage was associated with temporally clustered cases in September–October. These findings demonstrate recombination between distinct EV-D68 subclades and underscore the importance of whole-genome surveillance for accurate viral characterization. Continued genomic monitoring is essential for detecting emerging variants with potential implications for transmissibility, pathogenicity, and public health preparedness. IMPORTANCE This study highlights an increased off-season circulation of Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) and a higher burden of disease in adults in 2025. The identification of a novel A2–B3 recombinant lineage provides evidence of ongoing viral evolution through recombination, a mechanism that may alter transmissibility, virulence, or immune responses. Detection of this lineage in temporally clustered cases suggests local transmission and underscores the potential for rapid spread of newly emerged variants. These findings emphasize the limitations of partial genomic approaches and the critical role of whole-genome sequencing in accurately characterizing circulating strains and identifying recombination events. Enhanced genomic surveillance is essential to detect emerging variants in real time, inform diagnostic assay performance, and support public health responses. Continued monitoring of EV-D68 evolution will be important for anticipating changes in disease burden, guiding clinical awareness, and strengthening preparedness for future outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) 已重新出现作为与严重呼吸道疾病相关的重大呼吸道病原体,并且与 急性弛缓性脊髓炎 相关,需要进一步研究其基因组 进化 和传播模式。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在2025年5月至12月期间,对呼吸道标本中检测到的鼻病毒/肠道病毒进行了EV-D68筛查,共测试了1,321名患者,其中147名(11.1%)为EV-D68阳性,119名(81.0%)获得了完整的基因组。
elements_zh.methods: 对EV-D68阳性标本进行了全基因组测序,并使用最大似然法进行了系统发育分析。通过亚基因组系统发育、SimPlot相似性分析和BootScan分析以及读级检查评估了重组现象。
elements_zh.main_results: 2025年7月EV-D68阳性率上升,8月达到峰值(约21%),并在9月至10月保持较高水平,超过了2024年观察到的水平。系统发育分析显示仅A2亚群在流行,其中五株基因组形成了一条独特的重组谱系(A2-Re),在P1区域与A2病毒聚类,在P2–P3区域与B3病毒聚类。在2A/2B接合处附近(约nt 3,700)发现了一个重组断点,该重组谱系与9月至10月期间的时间聚集病例相关。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对呼吸道样本的依赖以及部分基因组方法可能错过重组事件的可能性而受到限制,但全 基因组 测序和多种分析方法的使用支持了对研究结果的适度信心。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) 已重新出现作为与严重呼吸道疾病相关的重大呼吸道病原体,并且与 急性弛缓性脊髓炎 相关,需要进一步研究其基因组 进化 和传播模式。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在2025年5月至12月期间,对呼吸道标本中检测到的鼻病毒/肠道病毒进行了EV-D68筛查,共测试了1,321名患者,其中147名(11.1%)为EV-D68阳性,119名(81.0%)获得了完整的基因组。
analysis_zh.methods: 对EV-D68阳性标本进行了全基因组测序,并使用最大似然法进行了系统发育分析。通过亚基因组系统发育、SimPlot相似性分析和BootScan分析以及读级检查评估了重组现象。
analysis_zh.main_results: 2025年7月EV-D68阳性率上升,8月达到峰值(约21%),并在9月至10月保持较高水平,超过了2024年观察到的水平。系统发育分析显示仅A2亚群在流行,其中五株基因组形成了一条独特的重组谱系(A2-Re),在P1区域与A2病毒聚类,在P2–P3区域与B3病毒聚类。在2A/2B接合处附近(约nt 3,700)发现了一个重组断点,该重组谱系与9月至10月期间的时间聚集病例相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 新A2–B3重组谱系的鉴定提供了病毒通过重组持续进化的证据,这种机制可能会改变病毒的传播能力、致病性或免疫应答。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了全基因组 监测 对准确病毒特征描述的重要性,并突显了新兴变种可能对公共卫生准备和应对策略的影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对呼吸道样本的依赖以及部分基因组方法可能错过重组事件的可能性而受到限制,但全 基因组 测序和多种分析方法的使用支持了对研究结果的适度信心。

papers.title: Epidemiological insights of hand, foot, and mouth disease: outbreak of Coxsackievirus A16 in Northern India
papers.abstract: Background Hand-and-foot-and-mouth disease (HFMD) is an important epidemiological problem in Asia with global dissemination potential. The causative agents are Coxsackievirus A16 (CVA16), Enterovirus -71 (EV-A71), and related serogroups, which mainly affects children <10 years. Since 2003, India has been witnessing outbreaks of HFMD from different regions.Methods This study included HFMD suspected patients from two outbreak-affected villages and peripheral health facilitie sduring September and October, 2025. Molecular investigation was carried out using PCR or etiological detection. The causative agent was isolated using the Vero E6 cell line.Results Of total 38 suspected cases, 14 (36.8%) were positive for enterovirus by PCR. Sequence analysis of the 5’non-coding region (5’ NCR) confirmed CVA16 in all the subjects. Of PCR positive samples, majority were from outbreak-affected villages (78.6%), while 21.4% were from hospitals. Papulovesicular lesions localized to the elbows and knees, and Oral ulcers involving the oral mucosa, tongue, and hard palate were documented in 78.5% and 71.4% of infected patients respectively. The CVA16 isolation from vesicular swabs reconfirmed the causative etiology.Conclusion The study establishes CVA16 as the etiological agent of the HFMD outbreak. Further a substantial gap was found between clinical diagnosis and laboratory confirmation, which advocates the necessity of strengthening laboratory-based surveillance.

papers.title: Seasonal Dynamics of Pediatric Herpangina and Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease in Catalonia, Spain (2014–2025)
papers.abstract: Background: Herpangina and hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) are common pediatric enterovirus syndromes, but long-term evidence from European primary care remains scarce. Methods: Primary care electronic health records from the public healthcare system in Catalonia, Spain, were retrospectively analyzed for the academic years 2014–2015 to 2024–2025 using International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision codes. Incidence trends, age and sex patterns, seasonal peak timing, and peak-to-peak dependence were assessed in children younger than 5 years. Results: A total of 137,460 diagnoses were identified, including 54,060 herpangina and 83,400 HFMD. Both syndromes showed recurrent bimodal seasonality aligned with school holidays. Peak magnitudes were negatively correlated at both 6-month and 1-year lags, consistent with susceptible depletion and replenishment. Before the pandemic, spring herpangina peaks shifted about 1.5 weeks later for each 1-week delay in Easter. Incidence declined sharply in 2020 and rebounded from autumn 2021, particularly for HFMD. Most diagnoses occurred in children aged 1–2 years, with a transient post-pandemic shift toward ages 3–4 years in the first post-pandemic season. Age-specific curves were highly synchronized, with no pediatric age group consistently preceding the others. Conclusions: This large primary care series, among the very few long-term European studies of herpangina and HFMD, supports structured seasonal dynamics shaped by school-calendar timing and susceptible dynamics over successive seasons. Long-term primary care surveillance may help interpret atypical transmission patterns and support pediatric preparedness when virologic surveillance is limited.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 5 岁以下儿童的 发病率 趋势、年龄和性别模式、季节性高峰时间以及峰峰依赖性进行了评估。
elements_zh.methods: 使用国际疾病分类第 10 版修订代码对 2014-2015 学年和 2024-2025 学年西班牙加泰罗尼亚公共医疗保健系统的初级保健电子健康记录进行了回顾性分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 累计确诊病例137,460例,其中疱疹性咽峡炎54,060例,手足口病83,400例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这个大型初级保健系列是欧洲极少数关于疱疹性咽峡炎和手足口病的长期研究之一,支持由学校日历时间和连续季节的易感动态形成的结构化季节性动态。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 长期初级保健 监测 可能有助于解释非典型 传播 模式,并在病毒学 监测 有限时支持儿科做好准备。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这种确定性提取基于检索到的全文证据。该消息来源没有明确报告独立评估的足够局限性,因此可信度较低。

papers.title: Transport and Attenuation of Human Viruses in Groundwater: Assessment of Adsorption-Induced Interfacial Inactivation and Evidence of Aggregation.
papers.abstract: Virus transport in groundwater is a key pathway contributing to waterborne disease outbreaks and poses significant risks to public health. However, the mechanisms governing virus transport and attenuation remain poorly understood. Here, using the human enteric virus Coxsackievirus (CV-A16), we coupled experiments with a dual-marker approach (TCID50 and RT-qPCR) and a stepwise modeling strategy to quantify virus inactivation, interfacial inactivation, and adsorption during virus transport and attenuation in heterogeneous sediments. Static batch experiments revealed markedly slower CV-A16 inactivation in the aqueous phase, requiring 106-191 days to achieve a 90% loss of infectivity, compared with about 12 days in saturated sediments. Column experiments indicated that kinetic adsorption-desorption was the dominant attenuation mechanism, while surface-associated interfacial inactivation represented an additional important pathway that increased with virus adsorption, reflecting a coupled adsorption-inactivation process. Further analysis showed that inactivation rate constants ranged from 0.002 to 0.004 min-1 from coarse sand to silt, suggesting enhanced virus-solid interface reactivity in finer sediments. Furthermore, bimodal particle-size distributions from laser particle sizing and TEM observations of virus clusters indicate the formation of aggregates during transport, while zeta potential variations suggest that this process most likely occurs during the early to intermediate stages of transport. By evaluating the interplay between physical retention and biological inactivation, this study provides a mechanistic framework to improve the prediction of virus transport and the accuracy of pathogen-related health risk assessments in subsurface environments.

papers.title_zh: 地下水中的病原体传播与衰减:吸附诱导界面失活的评估及聚集现象的证据。
papers.source_body_en: Virus transport in groundwater is a key pathway contributing to waterborne disease outbreaks and poses significant risks to public health. However, the mechanisms governing virus transport and attenuation remain poorly understood. Here, using the human enteric virus Coxsackievirus (CV-A16), we coupled experiments with a dual-marker approach (TCID50 and RT-qPCR) and a stepwise modeling strategy to quantify virus inactivation, interfacial inactivation, and adsorption during virus transport and attenuation in heterogeneous sediments. Static batch experiments revealed markedly slower CV-A16 inactivation in the aqueous phase, requiring 106-191 days to achieve a 90% loss of infectivity, compared with about 12 days in saturated sediments. Column experiments indicated that kinetic adsorption-desorption was the dominant attenuation mechanism, while surface-associated interfacial inactivation represented an additional important pathway that increased with virus adsorption, reflecting a coupled adsorption-inactivation process. Further analysis showed that inactivation rate constants ranged from 0.002 to 0.004 min-1 from coarse sand to silt, suggesting enhanced virus-solid interface reactivity in finer sediments. Furthermore, bimodal particle-size distributions from laser particle sizing and TEM observations of virus clusters indicate the formation of aggregates during transport, while zeta potential variations suggest that this process most likely occurs during the early to intermediate stages of transport. By evaluating the interplay between physical retention and biological inactivation, this study provides a mechanistic framework to improve the prediction of virus transport and the accuracy of pathogen-related health risk assessments in subsurface environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 地下水中的病毒传播是导致水传播疾病 暴发 的关键途径,并对公众健康构成重大风险。然而,人们对病毒运输和减毒的机制仍知之甚少。在这里,我们使用人类肠道病毒柯萨奇病毒(CV-A16),将实验与双标记方法(TCID50和RT-qPCR)和逐步建模策略相结合,以量化病毒在异质沉积物中运输和减毒过程中的病毒失活、界面失活和吸附。静态批量实验表明,CV-A16 在水相中的灭活速度明显较慢,需要 106-191 天才能实现感染性损失 90%,而在饱和沉积物中则需要约 12 天。柱实验表明,动力学吸附-解吸是主要的衰减机制,而表面相关的界面失活代表了随着病毒吸附而增加的另一个重要途径,反映了吸附-失活的耦合过程。进一步分析表明,从粗砂到淤泥,灭活速率常数范围为 0.002 至 0.004 min-1,这表明较细沉积物中的病毒-固体界面反应性增强。此外,激光粒度测定和病毒簇 TEM 观察得出的双峰粒度分布表明在运输过程中形成了聚集体,而 zeta 电位变化表明该过程最有可能发生在运输的早期到中期阶段。通过评估物理滞留和生物灭活之间的相互作用,本研究提供了一个机制框架,以提高地下环境中病毒传播的预测和病原体相关健康风险评估的准确性。

papers.title: Development of a lethal adult mouse model of Coxsackievirus B1 infection for antiviral research
papers.abstract: Coxsackievirus B1 (CVB1), a clinically significant human enterovirus, causes a wide spectrum of diseases ranging from mild illness to severe, life-threatening conditions in susceptible individuals. However, investigations into CVB1 infection pathogenesis, as well as the development and evaluation of antiviral strategies, have long been constrained by the lack of immunocompetent animal models that recapitulate human CVB1 infections. In this study, we established a lethal CVB1 infection model in immunocompetent adult BALB/c mice. Using a reverse genetics approach, we generated the CVB1-XM0108 virus from a clinical isolate and infected adult BALB/c mice. Our results demonstrated that this virus exhibited a strong tropism for the pancreas, liver, and skeletal muscles, leading to extensive inflammation in these organs. Passive immunization with anti-CVB1 serum dose-dependently reduced viral replication, tissue damage, weight loss, and mortality. This pathologically relevant mouse model provides a valuable platform for advancing CVB1 therapeutic and vaccine development.

papers.title_zh: 用于 抗病毒药物 研究的柯萨奇病毒 B1 感染致死成年小鼠模型的开发
papers.source_body_en: Coxsackievirus B1 (CVB1), a clinically significant human enterovirus, causes a wide spectrum of diseases ranging from mild illness to severe, life-threatening conditions in susceptible individuals. However, investigations into CVB1 infection pathogenesis, as well as the development and evaluation of antiviral strategies, have long been constrained by the lack of immunocompetent animal models that recapitulate human CVB1 infections. In this study, we established a lethal CVB1 infection model in immunocompetent adult BALB/c mice. Using a reverse genetics approach, we generated the CVB1-XM0108 virus from a clinical isolate and infected adult BALB/c mice. Our results demonstrated that this virus exhibited a strong tropism for the pancreas, liver, and skeletal muscles, leading to extensive inflammation in these organs. Passive immunization with anti-CVB1 serum dose-dependently reduced viral replication, tissue damage, weight loss, and mortality. This pathologically relevant mouse model provides a valuable platform for advancing CVB1 therapeutic and vaccine development.

papers.title: Selective Whole-Blood Expression of Interferon-Stimulated Genes and TLR3/TLR7 in Type 1 Diabetes with Minimal Enterovirus-Targeted Amplification in Whole Blood
papers.abstract: Background: Enteroviruses (EVs) have been proposed as environmental triggers in type 1 diabetes (T1D), potentially through activation of innate immune pathways and type I interferon (IFN) responses. However, the relationship between detectable viral infection and IFN-related transcriptional responses remains unclear. Methods: In this cross-sectional, exploratory study, peripheral blood samples from individuals with new-onset T1D, established T1D, and healthy controls were analyzed by an enterovirus 5′NCR-targeted RT-PCR assay and for the expression of innate immune receptors (TLR3, TLR7, TLR8), interferon-stimulated genes (IFI27, IFIT1, ISG15, IFI44L, RSAD2, SIGLEC1), and FOXP3, assessed as an exploratory marker related to regulatory T-cell biology potentially influenced by type I interferon signaling. Gene expression was assessed by quantitative RT-PCR, and comparisons were performed between groups. Results: Enterovirus-targeted amplification was observed in only one T1D sample under the applied assay conditions. In the setting of limited enterovirus-targeted amplification under the applied assay conditions, TLR3 was significantly increased in established T1D, while TLR7 was increased in both new-onset and established T1D, with the highest levels in established disease; these differences remained significant after correction for multiple comparisons across the full gene panel. Several of the selected interferon-stimulated genes showed group-specific expression patterns: IFI27 and RSAD2 were significantly increased in new-onset T1D, whereas IFIT1 and ISG15 were more evident in established T1D. SIGLEC1 and IFI44L showed no significant differences. FOXP3 transcript abundance was also increased in both diabetic groups, a finding that correlated with lymphocyte proportion and is interpreted with caution. Conclusions: These findings indicate group-specific differences in whole-blood transcript expression of selected RNA-sensing and IFN-related genes in T1D under conditions in which enterovirus-targeted amplification was observed in only one sample. Given the cross-sectional whole-blood design and the analytical limitations of the EV assay, these results are hypothesis-generating and do not establish the presence or absence of systemic enterovirus infection or functional pathway activation.

elements_zh.methods: 通过定量 RT-PCR 评估基因表达,并在组间进行比较。在本研究中,采用肠道病毒 5'NCR 靶向 RT-PCR 检测来分析病毒感染,由于横断面全血设计和 EV 检测的分析局限性,对结果的解释需谨慎。
elements_zh.main_results: 在所应用的检测条件下,仅在一份 T1D 样本中观察到肠道病毒靶向扩增。TLR3 在已确诊的 T1D 中显着升高,而 TLR7 在新发 T1D 和已确诊的 T1D 中均升高,且在已确诊的 T1D 中水平最高。几个选定的干扰素刺激基因显示出群体特异性表达模式:IFI27 和 RSAD2 在新发 T1D 中显着增加,而 IFIT1 和 ISG15 在既定 T1D 中更为明显。SIGLEC1 和 IFI44L 没有表现出显着差异。两个糖尿病组中 FOXP3 转录丰度也有所增加,这一发现与淋巴细胞比例相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,在仅在一个样本中观察到肠道病毒靶向扩增的条件下,T1D 中选定的 RNA 感应和 IFN 相关基因的全血转录本表达存在群体特异性差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来研究肠道病毒在1型糖尿病中的作用以及IFN相关通路在疾病进展中的潜在参与提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 鉴于采用的是横断面全血设计以及EV检测的分析局限性,这些结果仅能提出假设,不能确定是否存在全身性肠道病毒感染或功能性通路激活。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Enteroviruses (EVs) have been proposed as environmental triggers in type 1 diabetes (T1D), potentially through activation of innate immune pathways and type I interferon (IFN) responses. However, the relationship between detectable viral infection and IFN-related transcriptional responses remains unclear.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This cross-sectional, exploratory study analyzed peripheral blood samples from individuals with new-onset T1D, established T1D, and healthy controls. The study aimed to assess the expression of innate immune receptors (TLR3, TLR7, TLR8), interferon-stimulated genes (IFI27, IFIT1, ISG15, IFI44L, RSAD2, SIGLEC1), and FOXP3 in these groups.
analysis_en.methods: Gene expression was assessed by quantitative RT-PCR, and comparisons were performed between groups. In this study, an enterovirus 5′NCR-targeted RT-PCR assay was used to analyze for viral infection, and the results were interpreted with caution due to the cross-sectional whole-blood design and the analytical limitations of the EV assay.
analysis_en.main_results: Enterovirus-targeted amplification was observed in only one T1D sample under the applied assay conditions. TLR3 was significantly increased in established T1D, while TLR7 was increased in both new-onset and established T1D, with the highest levels in established disease. Several of the selected interferon-stimulated genes showed group-specific expression patterns: IFI27 and RSAD2 were significantly increased in new-onset T1D, whereas IFIT1 and ISG15 were more evident in established T1D. SIGLEC1 and IFI44L showed no significant differences. FOXP3 transcript abundance was also increased in both diabetic groups, a finding that correlated with lymphocyte proportion.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings indicate group-specific differences in whole-blood transcript expression of selected RNA-sensing and IFN-related genes in T1D under conditions in which enterovirus-targeted amplification was observed in only one sample.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform future studies on the role of enteroviruses in T1D pathogenesis and the potential involvement of IFN-related pathways in disease progression.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Given the cross-sectional whole-blood design and the analytical limitations of the EV assay, these results are hypothesis-generating and do not establish the presence or absence of systemic enterovirus infection or functional pathway activation.

papers.title_zh: 1 型糖尿病中干扰素刺激基因和 TLR3/TLR7 的选择性全血表达,全血中肠道病毒靶向扩增最小化
papers.source_body_en: Background: Enteroviruses (EVs) have been proposed as environmental triggers in type 1 diabetes (T1D), potentially through activation of innate immune pathways and type I interferon (IFN) responses. However, the relationship between detectable viral infection and IFN-related transcriptional responses remains unclear. Methods: In this cross-sectional, exploratory study, peripheral blood samples from individuals with new-onset T1D, established T1D, and healthy controls were analyzed by an enterovirus 5′NCR-targeted RT-PCR assay and for the expression of innate immune receptors (TLR3, TLR7, TLR8), interferon-stimulated genes (IFI27, IFIT1, ISG15, IFI44L, RSAD2, SIGLEC1), and FOXP3, assessed as an exploratory marker related to regulatory T-cell biology potentially influenced by type I interferon signaling. Gene expression was assessed by quantitative RT-PCR, and comparisons were performed between groups. Results: Enterovirus-targeted amplification was observed in only one T1D sample under the applied assay conditions. In the setting of limited enterovirus-targeted amplification under the applied assay conditions, TLR3 was significantly increased in established T1D, while TLR7 was increased in both new-onset and established T1D, with the highest levels in established disease; these differences remained significant after correction for multiple comparisons across the full gene panel. Several of the selected interferon-stimulated genes showed group-specific expression patterns: IFI27 and RSAD2 were significantly increased in new-onset T1D, whereas IFIT1 and ISG15 were more evident in established T1D. SIGLEC1 and IFI44L showed no significant differences. FOXP3 transcript abundance was also increased in both diabetic groups, a finding that correlated with lymphocyte proportion and is interpreted with caution. Conclusions: These findings indicate group-specific differences in whole-blood transcript expression of selected RNA-sensing and IFN-related genes in T1D under conditions in which enterovirus-targeted amplification was observed in only one sample. Given the cross-sectional whole-blood design and the analytical limitations of the EV assay, these results are hypothesis-generating and do not establish the presence or absence of systemic enterovirus infection or functional pathway activation.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:肠道病毒 (EV) 已被认为是 1 型糖尿病 (T1D) 的环境触发因素,可能通过激活先天免疫途径和 I 型干扰素 (IFN) 反应来实现。然而,可检测的病毒感染与 IFN 相关转录反应之间的关系仍不清楚。方法:在这项横断面探索性研究中,通过肠道病毒 5'NCR 靶向 RT-PCR 检测对新发 T1D 患者、既定 T1D 患者和健康对照者的外周血样本进行了分析,以检测先天免疫受体(TLR3、TLR7、TLR8)、干扰素刺激基因(IFI27、IFIT1、ISG15、IFI44L、RSAD2、SIGLEC1)、 FOXP3,被评估为与可能受 I 型干扰素信号传导影响的调节性 T 细胞生物学相关的探索性标记物。通过定量 RT-PCR 评估基因表达,并在组间进行比较。结果:在所应用的检测条件下,仅在一份 T1D 样本中观察到肠道病毒靶向扩增。在所应用的检测条件下,在有限肠道病毒靶向扩增的情况下,TLR3在已确诊的T1D中显着增加,而TLR7在新发和已确诊的T1D中均增加,且在已确诊的疾病中水平最高;在对整个基因组进行多重比较校正后,这些差异仍然显着。几个选定的干扰素刺激基因显示出群体特异性表达模式:IFI27 和 RSAD2 在新发 T1D 中显着增加,而 IFIT1 和 ISG15 在既定 T1D 中更为明显。SIGLEC1 和 IFI44L 没有表现出显着差异。两个糖尿病组中 FOXP3 转录丰度也有所增加,这一发现与淋巴细胞比例相关,需要谨慎解释。结论:这些发现表明,在仅在一个样本中观察到肠道病毒靶向扩增的情况下,T1D 中选定的 RNA 感应和 IFN 相关基因的全血转录本表达存在群体特异性差异。考虑到横断面全血设计和 EV 测定的分析局限性,这些结果只是假设生成,并不能确定是否存在全身性肠道病毒感染或功能途径激活。
